The file could not be read or saved. Check file access and available storage, then select it again.

The text cannot be read with this encoding. Try another encoding.
This text encoding is not supported. Choose an encoding from the list.

The chapter rule is too long. Shorten it to 1,024 characters or fewer.
The EPUB contains more than 10,000 chapters. Split the original book.
No readable content was found. Check the file contents; for TXT, also check the encoding and chapter rule.
The EPUB is incomplete or damaged. Download or export the original file again.
This EPUB contains encrypted text or images and cannot be imported.
This EPUB uses unsupported content or vector artwork. Convert it to an EPUB with HTML text and PNG or JPEG images.
The expanded EPUB is too large or its structure is too complex. Simplify or split the original book.
This import session has ended. Go back and select the original file again.
Enter a book title of 1 to 200 characters.
